Panjab ke sangrur men parali jalane ki ghatnaon par lagam lagane ke lie prashasan ne dron se nigrani aur jiyo-taiging jaise sakht upay apnae hain. prashasan ka dava hai ki isse parali jalane ki ghatnaon par nazar rakhna aasan huaa hai. lekin kisanon ka kahna hai ki in upayon se unke bich dar barha hai.
